mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portfolio_holdings ( portfolio_holding_id, portfolio_id, instrument_id, quantity, avg_cost, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{portfolioHoldingId}, #{portfolioId}, #{instrumentId}, #{quantity}, #{avgCost}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
